commentary.text: 90+9' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.
90+7' NO PENALTY! Referee Andy Madley has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Everton players are incensed.
90+4' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Everton, he's going to review using VAR.
90+4' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Andy Madley signals a set piece. It's a penalty for Everton!

90+4' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
90+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
90+2' Jack Harrison (Everton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+2' Ashley Young (Everton) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
90+1' The attendance is 39290.

90' Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared.

89' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
89' 8:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.

86' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.

84' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Manchester Utd, play can continue.

84' Surely that's handball by one of the Everton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

26' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
23' Andy Madley sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
20' The Everton players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Abdoulaye Doucoure gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Beto (Everton), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:0.
19' Everton get a corner.
